environment.description: EKS pod deployed via Flux GitOps with Kyverno admission policy 'restrict-volume-types' enforcing ephemeral-only mounts. Container entrypoint wraps process with pivot_root(2) into /srv/empty (a statically-provisioned emptyDir with mode 0555). The pod spec includes a securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem:true and an init container that creates the chroot directory structure containing only the application binary and gRPC proto descriptors. The pod runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) and the container's /proc/self/root resolves to the pivoted filesystem. Sensitive paths (/etc/shadow, /var/run/secrets/, mounted ConfigMaps) exist in the outer mount namespace but are unreachable from within the pivot_root boundary. The emptyDir backing the chroot jail is sized at 10Mi with medium:Memory, containing no credential material.

config.init_container: alpine:3.19 - copies binary and descriptors only
